title: Support @Suffix Token in Tech Data Prompts
changes: Added dynamic token replacement for @Suffix in Top Image prompt and Bottom Image prompt templates in the Tech Data drawer.
Resolves the suffix of the final image in the 'Image with Text' stage (Stage 4), or replaces with an empty string if no suffix is set.

title: Same-Row Layout for Text Generation in Tech Data Drawer
changes: Arranged Top Sentence and Bottom Sentence text inputs side-by-side into the same row in the Tech Data drawer.
Consolidated Top Text Offset, Bottom Text Offset, and Font Size into a unified 3-column row for a compact, clean layout.

title: Optional Image Suffix for Google Drive Image Uploads
changes: Added an optional 'Image suffix' input box to the right of the Google Drive link input in Stage 3 and Stage 4 image upload cards.
Allowed up to 20 characters for the image suffix using native maxlength without character restrictions.
Added inline click-to-edit and '+ Suffix' button directly inside the Google Drive link pill to the left of the Download button.

title: Favicon Boundary Clipping & Heart Clearance
changes: Added SVG squircle clip-path (<clipPath id="squircleClip">) ensuring all animal artwork stays strictly inside the rounded badge boundary.
Re-anchored animal positions and placed the love heart high in the open upper-center area with zero overlap onto the giraffe or elephant.

title: Enhance Favicon Animal Visibility & Contrast
changes: Redesigned public/favicon.svg into bold, closeup portraits of the Elephant (#A) and Giraffe (#B) filling the canvas.
Added crisp dark perimeter contours and outlines around both characters, ears, horns, trunk, and neck for clarity at 16px/32px tab sizes.
Repositioned the love heart cleanly above both characters so neither face or horn is obscured.

title: PilGi Duo Application Favicon
changes: Created official vector SVG application favicon (public/favicon.svg) featuring the iconic Elephant (#A) and Giraffe (#B) companions with floating heart.
Embedded squircle badge styling with automatic light and dark browser theme adaptability.
Linked favicon and updated page title to 'PilGi Image Manager' in index.html.

title: Default to Paste Sentences in Batch Import
changes: Made 'Paste sentences' the default active mode and the first option in the segmented toggle in Batch Import.

title: Add Margin Beneath Batch Import Toggle
changes: Added spacing (var(--space-6)) underneath the 'Upload file / Paste sentences' segmented toggle in Batch Import for proper visual breathing room and separation from content cards.

title: Paste Sentences Support in Batch Import
changes: Added a 'Paste sentences' tab in Batch Import alongside 'Upload file' allowing direct text entry.
Supported multiple pasted text formats: Google Sheets / Excel tab-separated columns, CSV, semicolon-separated, pipe-separated (Top | Bottom), alternating paired lines, and JSON arrays.
Added 'Paste from clipboard' quick action with browser clipboard access.
Added automatic Hebrew RTL support in both the paste textarea and the sentence preview editors.
Made top and bottom sentences directly editable in the import preview table so users can fix missing sentences or polish text before creation.
Added select-all / deselect-all master checkbox in preview table header for effortless row selection.

title: Remove Floating Copy Button from Stage 1 Sentences Card
changes: Removed the top-right floating copy button from inside the Stage 1 Sentences card in favor of the dedicated 'Copy sentences' action button in the review row below.

title: Align Edit Button Styling with Action Bar Buttons
changes: Updated 'Edit sentences' (and 'Edit scenario') button to use secondary button styling (btn btn-secondary) with a pencil icon, matching the other action buttons in the review card.

title: Set Stage 5 Google Drive Preview Width to 75%
changes: Set Stage 5 Google Drive preview iframe container and action bar width to 75% to match Stages 3 and 4.

title: Remove Scenario Tag from Scenario Viewer Card
changes: Removed the 'Scenario' tag badge from the Stage 2 viewer box for a cleaner presentation matching the Stage 1 Sentences card.

title: Unify Stage 5 Drive Link Bar with Stage 4 Layout
changes: Updated Stage 5 Google Drive link bar to use the same rounded pill container, link preview, and action buttons ('Download' and 'Open in Drive') as Stage 4.
Moved the 'Image with text · Final asset' version descriptor directly underneath the Drive action bar.

title: Rename Stage 1 to Sentences Across App
changes: Renamed Stage 1 from 'Text' to 'Sentences' in stage name definitions (SN), dashboard stage tiles/filters, and record progress steps.
Updated Stage 1 actions and buttons to refer to sentences ('Approve sentences', 'Edit sentences', 'Update sentences', 'Copy sentences').
Updated Stage 1 descriptions and subsection titles in Record Detail, Tech Data Drawer, and dialogs.

title: Relocate Text Update Action Above Version History
changes: Moved the 'Update text' action button in Stage 1 from the version details card to sit directly above Version History.
Unified Stage 1 and Stage 2 update behavior above Version History for complete consistency across all workflow stages.

title: Relocate Scenario Update Action Above Version History
changes: Moved the 'Update scenario' action button in Stage 2 from the version details card to sit directly above Version History.
Clicking 'Update scenario' seamlessly opens the scenario editor prefilled with the latest scenario content.

title: Relocate Image Stage Update Actions Above Version Gallery
changes: Moved the 'Update clean image' (Stage 3) and 'Update image with text' (Stage 4) action buttons from the version details card to sit directly above the Version Gallery.
Clicking the update button smoothly opens the image upload input directly above the gallery for an intuitive update workflow.

title: Unify Version Gallery Layout Across Image Stages
changes: Applied Stage 4's version gallery row layout with 150px 4:3 Drive preview and complete metadata (version, status tag, author, and reviewer comments) to Stage 3.
Unified the Version Gallery design across both image generation stages (Stage 3 and Stage 4).

title: Match Stage 4 Version Gallery Preview Size to Stage 3
changes: Enlarged the embedded Google Drive image preview in Stage 4 Version gallery list items to 150px with a 4:3 aspect ratio, matching Stage 3's preview dimensions.
Preserved the existing list row layout and metadata display (version number, status badge, author info, and review comments) in Stage 4.

title: Rename Stage 4 Version List to Version Gallery
changes: Renamed the Stage 4 version list header from 'Review history' to 'Version gallery' to maintain consistent terminology across image stages.

title: Multi-Image Upload and Single Approval per Stage
changes: Allowed uploading multiple candidate images to Stage 3 (Clean image) and Stage 4 (Image with text) before review, without being blocked by pending status.
Added support for pasting multiple Google Drive links simultaneously in the image upload input to batch-create versions in a single commit.
Enforced strict single-approval invariant: exactly one version can be approved per stage. Approving a new version supersedes any previously approved version in that stage.
Added approval replacement confirmation and contextual button labeling ('Approve & replace vX') when an approved version already exists.

title: Search by Scenario on Dashboard
changes: Updated Dashboard live search to search Stage 2 scenario text in addition to Stage 1 sentences and PilGi ID.
Supports matching both raw scenario tokens (#A, #B) and substituted character names (e.g. Elephant, Giraffe).
Updated the search input placeholder to 'Search sentences, scenario, or pilgi id'.

title: Copy Stage 1 Text to Clipboard
changes: Added a quick copy-to-clipboard icon button in the top-right corner of the Stage 1 caption card.
Added a 'Copy text' action button with copy icon in the Stage 1 review action bar.
Copies top and bottom sentences cleanly to the clipboard with visual checkmark feedback upon copying.

title: Display Latest Approved Stage 4 Image in Stage 5
changes: Updated Stage 5 asset preview and download links to display the latest approved image version from Stage 4 instead of the first approved version.
Added latestApprovedVersion helper in domain.ts to resolve the latest approved version in a stage.
Updated stage step indicator subtitles to reflect the latest approved version number.

title: Animated Elephant and Giraffe Companions in Nav Header
changes: Added cute animated vector illustrations of the Elephant (#A) and Giraffe (#B) walking along the bottom border of the nav header with smooth quadruped walking gaits.
Given each animal independent random speeds, wander intervals, and movement directions along the border.
Added encounter interactions: when the animals meet, they pause to face each other and release floating, bubbling heart particles that drift up and fade out.
Added seeking behavior: if the animals have not met for more than 15 seconds, they automatically turn and walk directly towards each other until they meet.
Replaced static speech quotes with dynamic random sentences from Stage 1 (top and bottom sentences) across the loaded records.
Flattened multiline Stage 1 sentences into single-line strings with clean whitespace separation and no text wrapping in speech bubbles.
Added automatic RTL direction and right-alignment support when speech bubbles display Hebrew sentences.
Added idle auto-speech: if neither animal is clicked for at least 6 seconds, a speech bubble automatically appears on a random animal every 6–10 seconds, resetting seamlessly upon user clicks.
Pauses animal movement on hover so users can easily click either animal to trigger dialogue and joyful hops.
Refined the Elephant vector illustration with a natural, less-curled trunk curve.
Preserved animal facing orientation during jump hops by isolating horizontal scaling from vertical bounce keyframes so animals never flip sides when hopping.
Prevented horizontal and vertical viewport scrollbars when speech bubbles appear near screen edges by clamping bubble boundaries dynamically and adapting tail alignment.

title: Reduce Stage 1 Textarea Height in Tech Data Panel
changes: Reduced the default height of the Top Sentence and Bottom Sentence text inputs in the Stage 1 Text Line Breaks section to a compact 52px.

title: Match Image Prompts Textarea Border Radius
changes: Applied var(--radius-md) border radius to the Top Image prompt and Bottom Image prompt textareas in the Tech Data panel.

title: Match Input Border Radius in Tech Data Panel
changes: Applied var(--radius-md) border radius to the Stage 1 Top and Bottom sentence text inputs in the Tech Data drawer to match the Scenario Prompt textarea styling.

title: Extend Tech Data Panel Width
changes: Extended width of the Tech Data drawer by 200px (from 480px to 680px) for a more spacious editing and prompt review layout.

title: Edit Stage 1 Text Line Breaks in Tech Data Panel
changes: Added Stage 1 Top and Bottom sentence line break editing directly in the Tech Data drawer under Text Generation.
Enabled real-time prompt updating with | delimiters as line breaks are adjusted in the editor.
Added 'Update line break' and 'Reset text' controls to persist line break adjustments in place on the record's version.
Added automatic RTL support for Hebrew text in the sentence textareas.

title: RTL Support for Approve and Reject Comments
changes: Added automatic RTL direction and alignment to review comments on active version cards and version history items when Hebrew characters are present.
Added dynamic RTL direction styling and attribute to the rejection comment dialog textarea when typing Hebrew text.

title: RTL Support for Hebrew Remarks
changes: Added automatic RTL direction and alignment to the remark bubble div when Hebrew characters are present.
Added RTL direction styling and attribute to the remark draft input when typing Hebrew text.
Added hasHebrew helper in domain logic to detect Hebrew character ranges.

title: Evaluate Last Remark for Open and Mine Filters
changes: Updated 'Open' remarks filter and split button counter to match records where the last open remark was not written by the current user and remarks are not set as done.
Updated 'Mine' remarks filter and split button counter to match records where the last open remark was written by the current user and remarks are not set as done.
Added lastOpenRemarkOf helper to domain logic for centralized open-state evaluation.

title: Quick Remarks Split Button in Navigation
changes: Added a segmented split button in the top navigation bar to the right of '+ New PilGi' showing live counts for Open and Mine remarks.
Open counter displays records with open remarks not written by the current user.
Mine counter displays records with open remarks written by the current user.
Clicking either button navigates to the records dashboard and activates the corresponding remarks filter.

title: Remarks Dashboard Filter
changes: Added a new remarks filter on Dashboard with options: All (ignore filter), ∗ Remarks (all records with remarks, ignoring done status), Open Remarks (records with open remarks not by current user), and My Remarks (records with open remarks by current user).
Persisted remarks filter state in UI store across navigation.

title: Preserve Previous Remarks History on Reopen
changes: Updated 'Reopen' in Remarks panel to only reopen the latest remarks cycle rather than reopening all previous conversations.
Preserved previous done markers and separating divider lines in the remarks timeline across cycles.
Maintained open status only for newly added remarks after a separating line.

title: Trailing Newline on Tech Data Prompts Copy
changes: Appended a trailing newline to the end of the text when copying Image Prompts to clipboard in the Tech Data panel (Top Image prompt, Bottom Image prompt, both prompts, and scenario prompt template).

title: Remarks Done Status & Separating Line
changes: Added option in Remarks side panel to set remarks status to Done or Reopen.
Rendered a distinguished separating divider line in the remarks timeline indicating when remarks were marked done and by whom.
Preserved ability to continuously add new remarks after setting done status, displaying them below the separating line.
Reflected remarks done status across Dashboard and Record Detail badges.

title: Extended Header Text in Record Detail
changes: Removed max-width constraint and text-wrap balance on DetailView header sentences to allow text to extend with fewer line breaks.

title: Inline Sentences in Record Detail Header
changes: Removed line breaks from top and bottom sentences in the Record Detail view header.

title: Inline Sentences in Records View
changes: Removed line breaks from top and bottom sentences in the Dashboard records table for compact, single-line display.

title: Text Generation Defaults to 0
changes: Set defaults for 'Top Text Offset', 'Bottom Text Offset', and 'Font Size' in Text Generation to 0.
Updated placeholders, fallback values, and reset actions in Tech Data drawer.

title: Tech Data Text Embedding Formatting
changes: In Tech Data Top and Bottom Image prompt previews, trimmed lines of @TopText and @BottomText.
Replaced newlines with pipe (|) separator for text generation embedding.

title: Project Rules & Guidelines (GEMINI.md)
changes: Created GEMINI.md documenting architectural conventions, workflow stages, and coding rules.
Codified rules for Tech Data panel, Drive direct downloads, table sorting, and versioning.

title: Google Drive Direct Download Links
changes: Added 'Download' button alongside 'Open in Drive' buttons in Record Detail view.
Uses Google Drive direct download URL structure: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=[ID].

title: Version History Changelog Modal
changes: Added interactive Version History dialog in Settings view, opened by clicking the version badge.
Created versions.json data file to record and track changes across all application releases.

title: Interactive Records Table Column Sorting
changes: Added column header sorting for all columns in the Dashboard Records table.
Clicking the PilGi header sorts records by record number (with ascending/descending toggle).
Added visual chevron direction indicators and hover states for sortable headers.

title: Tech Data Prompt Generation & Copy Tools
changes: Added Top Image prompt and Bottom Image prompt preview text areas in Text Generation card.
Implemented automated @ token replacements (@Record, @TopText, @BottomText, @FontSize, @TextCenter, @TopLocation, @BottomLocation).
Added copy-to-clipboard icons for individual prompts and a combined copy button for both prompts.

title: Top Text Location Configuration
changes: Set default 'Top Text Location' coordinate to 700 across configuration and Tech Data fallbacks.

title: Application Version Badge & Settings Header Redesign
changes: Added build date version indicator badge in Settings with user avatar pill styling.
Restructured Settings header layout placing descriptive subtitle beneath action controls.
Added 'Center Align' setting with default value 768.

title: Tech Data Side Drawer
changes: Added 'Tech Data' slide-over drawer accessible from Record Detail under 'Last modified'.
Card 1: Scenario preview with dynamic #A and #B character replacements and Image Prompt template.
Card 2: Text Generation technical overrides (Top Text Offset, Bottom Text Offset, Font Size) saved to record.

title: Line Break Editing for Approved Records
changes: Allowed updating line breaks directly on the final approved text version without creating a new version.

title: Text Area Inputs for Top and Bottom Sentences
changes: Converted single-line text inputs for top and bottom sentences to multi-line text areas across New PilGi creation and Stage 1 editing.

title: GitHub Sync & Time Zone Settings
changes: Added direct GitHub repository persistence for records and settings.
Implemented time zone preferences with support for Israel, UTC, US, European, and Asian time zones.

title: Initial Release
changes: Full 5-stage PilGi pipeline (Text, Scenario, Clean Image, Image with Text, Posting).
Dashboard with review metrics, filtering, and live search.
CSV and JSON batch import support.
